_comment: Dimwit promotion profile (task 1). DEFAULT = current behavior exactly: 0.70 threshold, equal dimension weights (empty map => arithmetic-mean overall, byte-identical to pre-profile runs). Per-class files (e.g. weapon.json, hostile_construct_enemy.json) overlay this. Thresholds RATCHET UP ONLY — the engine clamps promote_threshold to max(promote_threshold, threshold_floor); a class may raise its bar, never lower it below the floor.
